question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e., **Quarentine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Quarentine"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Quarantine"**.
 
• **Quarantine** refers to a state, period, or place of isolation in which people or animals that have been exposed to infectious or contagious diseases are placed. (संगरोध)
 
 
• **Example:** After travelling internationally, he had to stay in **quarantine** for two weeks to ensure he wasn’t carrying the virus.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Practice** (अभ्यास): The act of repeatedly doing an activity to improve a skill.

 
 
• **Example:** Consistent **practice** will make you better at playing the piano.
 
 
 
• **Concentrate** (ध्यान केंद्रित करना): To focus all your attention on a particular task or subject.
 
 
• **Example:** It's hard to **concentrate** when there is so much noise around.
 
 
 
• **Elicit** (प्राप्त करना): To draw out a response, answer, or fact from someone in reaction to one's actions or questions.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher’s question was designed to **elicit **thoughtful responses from the students.
